page.content:
Dossier on the back of every blister: code name, birthplace, and a Hama paragraph.

How File cards connects

  • Creator: Larry Hama — Larry Hama wrote many of the file-card dossiers on the figure packages.
  • Work: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero — File cards are the printed dossiers of the Real American Hero line.

What is File cards?

File cards are the printed bios Hasbro packed with A Real American Hero figures — MOS, birthplace, and a short character essay, many written by Larry Hama — that turned toys into a readable roster.

Key threads lead to Larry Hama and G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero.
